{{Quote|The Droid IG-88 has taken over a very sensitive factory location of my masters. IG-88 is attempting to replicate himself. My master needs him removed before he draws unwanted attention.|[[Nym's Envoy]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:NS" />}}
'''Nym's Factory Compound''' was building on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] that was used by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] to hide his treasure. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] began production of droids in the compound for its [[IG-88's Droid Army|droid army]], but its plans were soon foiled when it was defeated by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in the [[Battle of Nym's Factory Compound]].

==Behind the scenes==
Nym's Factory Compound was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EtFC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nym's Factory Compound was the site of the [[W:c:swg:IG-88|"IG-88" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:IG88" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
